categories.main_business_segments: Ropeok Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the software and information technology services industry, focusing on AI-powered public safety system solutions, security video monitoring product development and sales, and maintenance and other related services. The company also extends its AI and big data technologies into sectors such as social governance, traffic management, emergency management, ecological environment, education, cultural tourism, agricultural internet, and digital ocean industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including artificial intelligence, big data analytics, cloud computing, IoT, edge computing, AI chips (including integrated computing-storage AI chips), machine vision, semantic analysis, machine learning, and multi-dimensional data fusion. It has developed a unified R&D platform (RUP) and multiple technology middle platforms (AI, IoT, big data, hardware) to accelerate product development and deployment. The company also emphasizes indigenous technology adaptation and integration with mainstream computing platforms such as NVIDIA GPU and Huawei Ascend AI chips.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ropeok serves primarily government agencies including public security bureaus, political and legal committees, prisons, traffic and municipal service institutions, military, and state-owned enterprises such as telecom operators. Its solutions target public safety, social governance, smart city infrastructure, emergency response, traffic management, environmental monitoring, education, healthcare, cultural tourism, agriculture, and maritime sectors across various provinces and cities in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with a focus on strategic cities and regions including Anhui, Chongqing, Hubei, Hebei, Yunnan, Sichuan, Shandong, Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, and others. It has established regional subsidiaries and research institutes to localize operations and deepen market penetration. The headquarters and main R&D centers are located in Xiamen, with additional facilities in Shanghai and other cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ropeok operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI and digital technology supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and intelligent hardware manufacturing. It provides end-to-end AI-enabled solutions and services, including product design, development, deployment, and after-sales maintenance, positioning itself as a technology provider and solution integrator rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes platform-based development focusing on channel construction, technological innovation, and talent growth. It invests heavily in R&D for AI core technologies, including multi-modal semantic recognition, large language models, edge computing, and AI chip integration. Ropeok collaborates with academic institutions and research centers, operates a national postdoctoral research station, and pursues industry-specific AI applications to accelerate digital transformation in smart cities, maritime economy, social governance, and other sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Ropeok generates revenue primarily through direct sales of AI-enabled public safety system solutions, security video monitoring products, and maintenance services. The company also earns income from customized software development, system integration projects, and ongoing operational support contracts, mainly through direct sales channels and government procurement projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the rapidly growing AI and software services market in China, particularly in public safety and smart city applications. It holds a competitive position by leveraging its integrated AI hardware-software capabilities, extensive regional presence, and strong R&D ecosystem. Ropeok is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and has received multiple industry awards, positioning itself as a leading AI solution provider in its niche.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Ropeok reported total assets of approximately RMB 1.9 billion and revenue of RMB 447.9 million, representing a 164.7% year-over-year increase. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 47.9 million, the loss narrowed significantly compared to the previous year. The company has shown strong revenue growth driven by expanded market penetration and improved project execution, while continuing to invest in R&D and maintain a solid asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ropeok emphasizes its integrated AI and big data technology platforms, combining proprietary AI chips, edge computing, and multi-modal AI algorithms to deliver customized, scalable, and high-efficiency solutions. Its value proposition lies in bridging the gap between advanced AI technologies and practical industry applications, enabling clients in public safety, social governance, and smart city sectors to enhance operational efficiency, safety, and digital transformation. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, strategic regional presence, and collaborative innovation ecosystem differentiate it from competitors.
